description: PvP rank-point milestone rewards: the item set granted at each score and its UI progress display.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_RankSystemReward. The reward list widget sorts rows by RequiredPoint, then locates a row by Id to compute its progress index; other consumers copy the whole row into list-item data. The grant path enumerates rows and does not use this id.

RequiredPoint.simple: PvP total score needed to unlock the reward.
RequiredPoint.technical: int32, default 0. GameShop_GrantRankSystemRewards skips rows whose RequiredPoint exceeds the saved EGameUserRecord::PvPTotalScore. The reward UI sorts rows by this value (ascending for progress, descending for the list) and computes self/next progress bars from neighbouring rows' RequiredPoint; the shop displays the pair (current score, required point) as unlock progress.

RewardType.technical: EGameRankSystemRewardType, default None; exported values include Nickname, Money, Costume and Plate. No direct consumer of RewardType was found in the available reconstructed Source/ or Plugins/ C++: the grant path keys everything from Id_ItemSet and the UI derives category from the underlying Item row. The precise behavioural role of this field remains unresolved here; absence of a consumer is an evidence limit, not proof that retail never reads it.

Id_ItemSet.simple: Item set awarded at this milestone.
Id_ItemSet.technical: FName, default None. The grant helper checks that the set is unlocked and not already in UserInfo.PvP.ReceivedRankSystemRewardItemSetIds, then calls GameShop_AddItemSet(id, 1, 3) and records the id. UI widgets use the same id to mark a reward received, resolve its first item for the icon/category and request its name text.

notes: The exported asset has 140 rows with FGameDataTableRow_RankSystemReward; the manager loads RankSystemRewardDataTable into RankSystemRewardDataTables (DTM+0xA80).
Only one reward per Id_ItemSet is effectively granted because received-set ids are recorded in user info; no consumer reads RewardType to decide the grant.
The grant helper 0x1301b60 / UI widgets are reconstructed; consult status/functions.json for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint reads of RewardType cannot be excluded.
No localization variants or numbered shards of this table were supplied; item-set name localization lives in the shop/item tables, not here.

usages.detail: Grants all unlocked, unclaimed rank rewards whose RequiredPoint has been reached.
Builds the reward list, marks received sets and opens item previews.
Displays point progress and reward name/icon from a copied row.
Uses RequiredPoint as unlock progress for PvP reward item sets.
